name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle unexpected issues during foundation repair coordination?
description: Hometelligent Inc. handles unexpected issues by communicating with clients, consulting engineers for plan revisions, and managing permit changes.

mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle unexpected issues during foundation repair coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: During foundation repair coordination, unexpected issues, such as discovering additional damage or encountering unforeseen site conditions, can arise. Hometelligent Inc. addresses these by promptly communicating with the client, consulting with the structural engineer for revised plans, and navigating any necessary permit modifications. Our experience in diverse terrains across the East Bay, including areas like Piedmont and Berkeley, helps us anticipate and mitigate potential challenges, minimizing delays and cost overruns.
